newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-American General estimates lowered.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-American General estimates lowered.

text.p: -- EVEREN Securities Inc said Tuesday it lowered its fourth-quarter and fiscal 1996 estimates for American General Corp by $0.10 each to $0.75 EPS and $3.08 EPS, respectively.
-- EVEREN said it is anticipating a continuing slow recovery in American General's consumer finance segment from last year's heavy loan losses.
-- EVEREN also lowered its estimate for fiscal 1997 earnings by $0.10 to $3.50 EPS to reflect dilution resulting from American General's purchase of Home Beneficial Corp.
-- EVEREN said it expects the acquisition will add to American General's earnings in subsequent years when the economies of the consolidation are realized.
-- American General is a consumer financial services company. Its stock was unchanged Tuesday at 40.
